name: Fellow Ode (Gen 1)
details: Electric flat-burr filter grinder (the first Ode); settings 1–11 with sub-steps.

grindRanges.scale: numbered settings 1–11, with two sub-steps between numbers (5.1 = 5⅓, 5.2 = 5⅔)

notes.turkish: The Ode (Gen 1) is a filter-only grinder.
notes.espresso: The Ode (Gen 1) is a filter-only grinder and doesn't grind fine enough for espresso.

rangeInfo.note: Fellow's Ode Brew Grinder Quick Start and Brewing Guide (grind settings page): 1–2 Prismo AeroPress attachment, 1–4 AeroPress, 2–3 cupping, 2–5 pour-over, 4–6 electric coffee maker, 6–10 French press, 9–11 cold brew. Not for the Ode Gen 2, whose numbers differ.
rangeInfo.estimateNote: Estimated by extrapolating the cited ranges, not from the source: moka pot: from the top of the espresso range to halfway to the top of the AeroPress range (or one AeroPress span finer when there's no espresso range); Rapid Brewer: from the middle of the AeroPress range to the middle of the pour-over range. Dial in from there.
